findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: umbrella_consumer_select, umbrella_consumer_service, homeowners_consumer_service · Private data: umbrella_consumer_prefill, homeowners_consumer_prefill, consumer_intake_issues, consumer_intake_patch, umbrella_consumer_select, umbrella_consumer_bind, umbrella_consumer_attach, umbrella_consumer_payment, umbrella_consumer_policy, umbrella_consumer_service, homeowners_consumer_select, homeowners_consumer_bind, homeowners_consumer_policy, homeowners_consumer_service, file_a_claim, homeowners_agent_finder · Public sink: umbrella_consumer_prefill, homeowners_consumer_prefill, consumer_intake_issues, consumer_intake_patch, umbrella_consumer_select, umbrella_consumer_bind, umbrella_consumer_attach, umbrella_consumer_payment, umbrella_consumer_service, homeowners_consumer_bind, homeowners_consumer_service.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: umbrella_consumer_select, umbrella_consumer_service, homeowners_consumer_service · Private data: umbrella_consumer_prefill, homeowners_consumer_prefill, consumer_intake_issues, consumer_intake_patch, umbrella_consumer_select, umbrella_consumer_bind, umbrella_consumer_attach, umbrella_consumer_payment, umbrella_consumer_policy, umbrella_consumer_service, homeowners_consumer_select, homeowners_consumer_bind, homeowners_consumer_policy, homeowners_consumer_service, file_a_claim, homeowners_agent_finder · Public sink: umbrella_consumer_prefill, homeowners_consumer_prefill, consumer_intake_issues, consumer_intake_patch, umbrella_consumer_select, umbrella_consumer_bind, umbrella_consumer_attach, umbrella_consumer_payment, umbrella_consumer_service, homeowners_consumer_bind, homeowners_consumer_service

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
